description: Attention fwd and fwd+bwd on H100, bf16, by implementation; labels pr123_* ran on perf/gpu-cpu-kernels 849e1d2 (generic dispatch), h100br_* on the device-defaults branch. Errors are max |difference| to flex_attention triton_split. cuDNN rows labelled main_* ran in the same session (cuDNN does not depend on the probjax revision). Labels h100_torch_*: probjax backends (flex:default/cudnn/triton) and PyTorch 2.14.1+cu130 (torch:flex = compiled torch.nn.attention.flex_attention with a create_block_mask from the KV lengths; torch:flash / torch:efficient = SDPA pinned to one backend, dense boolean mask for the latter), on the same inputs; torch rows ran without JAX preallocation. flex:mosaic rows: flex_attention(implementation='mosaic') with the Mosaic KV-length kernels.
